items.Sentence: Secondary waste water treatment is provided by primary sedimentation tanks, anaerobic digesters, and unlined oxidation ponds.
Secondary waste water treatment is provided by primary sedimentation tanks, anaerobic digesters, and unlined oxidation ponds.
Secondary treatment is provided by oxidation ponds located at both the 30th and 40th Street East sites.

Additional treatment is provided by the oxidation pond aeration system and disinfection facilities (chlorination) as shown in the Facilities Process Schematic included as Attachment D, which is made a part of this Order.

Additional treatment is provided by the oxidation pond aeration system and disinfection facilities (chlorination) as shown in the Facilities Process Schematic included as Attachment D, which is made a part of this Order.
The Tertiary Treatment Reclamation Plant design includes dissolved air flotation units, which will thicken waste activated sludge.
Filter backwash will be routed to the sedimentation tanks.
Digested sludge will be mechanically dewatered and/or solar dried in existing sludge drying beds before offsite disposal or reuse.
Sludge from the anaerobic digesters is dried in the concrete-lined drying beds, stockpiled, and hauled off site for disposal.
Two storage reservoirs (Reservoirs Nos. 1 and 2) have been completed and are in use at the Storage Reservoir Site.

The effluent generated by the Tertiary Treatment Reclamation Plant will be disinfected tertiary recycled water, as shown in the Tertiary Treatment Reclamation Plant Process Schematic included as Attachment F, which is made a part of this Order.
